QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_27

question.text: Impact Assessment Evidence under Section 5.8 can take which forms?

answer.text: Only physical and analytical - oral evidence is explicitly excluded for SSE work

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.123 lists four forms of impact assessment evidence: Documentary (reports, notes), Oral (discussions with stakeholders), Physical (asset inspection), and Analytical (derived via comparisons, calculations, relationships). All four are recognized forms. The page also states that inconsistencies arising from oral evidence should be noted by the SIA. The Trap: A and B incorrectly narrow the evidence set; oral evidence is expressly included on p.123. D confuses SIA evidence with financial-statement audit data. Note: The p.123 guidance to note oral-evidence inconsistencies is the key procedural point - record any divergence between testimonies in working papers.
